data.name: Settings_ShortcutsNote
data.value: Click a box, then press the key combination you want. During recording, Esc cancels. Alt + Space (window menu) and Win + H (Windows voice typing) are used by Windows, so they're avoided.

data.name: Settings_TranslationNote
data.value: The "Translate and Type" shortcut translates into the first selected language in the list. While recording, you can switch between "As spoken" and the selected languages in the HUD (the text is typed in the language selected when you stop). Translation uses the AI selected for dictation on the "AI" tab. Select at least one.

data.name: Settings_Engine_WindowsNote
data.value: Recognizes speech with Windows speech recognition (dictation) and shows partial results while you speak. It uses Microsoft's online speech recognition, so turn on "Online speech recognition" in Windows Settings → Privacy & security → Speech. It uses the Windows default microphone (the selection below isn't used).
data.comment: Settings: note; use the names shown in Windows Settings

data.name: Settings_Engine_WhisperNote
data.value: whisper.cpp transcribes on this PC (audio never leaves it), all at once after you stop recording. As soon as you choose the engine or a model, the selected model (sizes are shown in the list) starts downloading from Hugging Face (you can stop it with “Cancel”). Larger models are more accurate but slower.
data.comment: Settings note under the Whisper engine

data.name: Settings_Engine_GeminiNote
data.value: Sends the recorded audio to Google's Gemini API (using the Gemini credentials set on the AI tab and the Gemini model for dictation) for transcription. Note that your audio is sent to Google. It's sent after you stop recording (up to 7 minutes at a time).

data.name: Settings_NoTargetNote
data.value: If no text field has focus (for example, the desktop is in front) or the app in front runs as administrator and can't be pasted into, the result is shown at the bottom of the screen. It stays until you close it, and you can copy it with "Copy" or by selecting the text.

data.name: Settings_Fallback_Keep
data.value: Also put it on the clipboard (just press Ctrl+V where you want it)

data.name: Settings_Fallback_Restore
data.value: Only show it and leave the clipboard unchanged (copy with "Copy" on the panel)

data.name: Settings_PlaySounds
data.value: Play sounds when recording starts and stops

data.name: Settings_Ai_Local
data.comment: Settings: AI list item: local LLM on this PC

data.name: Settings_AiNote
data.value: You can choose the AI and model separately for dictation and meetings. The defaults are gemini-3.5-flash-lite (dictation) and gemini-3.8-flash (minutes) for Gemini, and Haiku 5.5 (dictation) and Sonnet 5.5 (minutes) for Claude. Claude is used only for processing text, not for transcribing audio (the transcription engine is on the "General" and "Meetings" tabs).

data.name: Settings_LocalModels
data.value: Local models (small LLMs that run on this PC)

data.name: Settings_LocalModelsNote
data.value: Text is processed only on this PC and never sent over the internet. Download the model you want to use first. It runs on the CPU, so refining takes a few to over ten seconds, and minutes take a few to over ten minutes.

data.name: Settings_Refine
data.value: Refine with AI (fix misrecognitions, filler words, self-corrections, and punctuation)

data.name: Settings_RefineNote
data.value: When off, only the dictionary replacements are applied to the recognized text before typing. Translation can only be done by AI, so it's still sent to the AI when this is off.

data.name: Settings_RefineLanguage_AsSpoken

data.name: Settings_RefineLanguage_Japanese

data.name: Settings_KeyJson

data.name: Settings_ServiceAccountNote
data.value: Choose the key of a service account with the Vertex AI User role (roles/aiplatform.user). Only the key file's location is saved (its contents aren't copied). Keep the key file where other people can't read it. The default region is global. “Test Connection” only reads the model's information and costs nothing.
data.comment: Settings note for the service account

data.name: Settings_ClaudeNote
data.value: Enter an API key created in the Claude Console (platform.claude.com). Saved keys aren't shown on screen (only the last 4 characters). "Test Connection" only retrieves model information and isn't charged.

data.name: Settings_UseHello
data.value: Protect API keys with Windows Hello (verify with your PIN, face, or fingerprint when they're used)

data.name: Settings_KeyProtectionNote
data.value: Keys are stored encrypted in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Hanasu\secrets.json, not in settings.json. With the default DPAPI, only this Windows user can read them, but other apps running as the same user can read them without confirmation. With Windows Hello, other apps trying to read them trigger a Windows Hello prompt (you verify once on first use after starting, and again after locking the screen). This can't prevent apps running as the same user from reading memory while Hanasu is running.
data.comment: Settings: note; keep the file paths

data.name: Settings_MeetingEngineNote
data.value: During recording, audio is only written to files; after you stop, the "Me" and "Others" channels are each transcribed with timestamps. Windows speech recognition can only listen to the Windows default microphone and can't take the PC audio (others), so it can't be used for meetings.

data.name: Settings_DiarizeNote
data.value: Speakers are separated on this PC with sherpa-onnx (pyannote and 3D-Speaker models). The models (about 34 MB) are downloaded the first time. When off, the other side is combined into a single "Others". You can rename speakers in Meeting Notes.

data.name: Settings_KeepAudioNote

data.name: Settings_MeetingsFolderNote
data.value: A folder named after the date and time is created for each meeting, containing meeting.json (same format as the Mac version), transcript.md, minutes.md, notes.md, and the audio.

data.name: Settings_HistoryNote
data.value: Keeps dictation results and the original transcripts so you can search and copy them with "Open History". When off, new results aren't written to a file; only the last 10 are kept in memory for "Recent Results" in the notification area menu (saved history isn't deleted).
